verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents a REST API (api.beglaubigt.de/v1) for creating and retrieving notarization, incorporation, translation, tax-registration and trade-registration requests. Status can be polled, and HMAC-signed webhooks deliver events, so core workflows can be driven programmatically without the UI. However, the evidence shows no CLI, CI integration, or published OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404). Parts of the workflow, such as identity verification and notary appointments, still rely on human or portal steps, so end-to-end headless runs are not shown. Missing for 10: CLI or CI-runner documentation, API authentication and key docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence of fully unattended end-to-end runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
